frontmatter.description: Turn any codebase, with docs, SQL schemas, and configs, into a queryable knowledge graph. Query architecture and cross-file connections with minimal token consumption.

frontmatter.description: Review changes like a lazy senior dev. Flags over-engineering, unneeded abstractions, new dependencies, and boilerplate.

frontmatter.description: Use when implementing logic, bug fixes, or new endpoints. Enforces the Red-Green-Refactor loop.
